_about: Household-level default assumptions. All real (after inflation).

wageGrowthReal._note: Typical real-wage curve: earnings rise faster early in a career and plateau in the early-mid 50s.

incomeStability._note: Premium over the real risk-free rate used to value future earnings. Ask: 'How steady is this income?'

very-steady.examples: nursing, teaching, government, regulated functions; pay rises in steps

typical.examples: salaried private-sector role at an established employer

bonus.examples: discretionary or performance bonus, valued separately from base

health.source: placeholder (~$1K/mo per person for marketplace coverage before Medicare); override with a real quote

childcare._note: default: paid care until the youngest is 13; ask to confirm

glide._note: Default mix at retirement if the household hasn't chosen one.
